secrets.name: POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN
secrets.description: PostHog project token for analytics (optional — app runs without it)

secrets.name: POSTHOG_HOST
secrets.description: PostHog host URL, e.g. https://us.i.posthog.com (optional — app runs without it)

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for AI premise suggestions (optional — falls back to deterministic mode)

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_BASE
secrets.description: OpenAI API base URL (optional — needed only if OPENAI_API_KEY is set)
